## How Heavy Is Helium?

Nearly all the mass of an atom sits in its nucleus, and at this time protons were the only particles known to be there. A hydrogen atom has 1 proton and a helium atom has 2 protons.

**Predict:** How heavy is a helium atom, compared with a hydrogen atom?

options.text: About the same, because protons decide the charge of an atom and not its mass.
About twice as heavy, because two protons should have twice the mass of one.
About four times as heavy, even though it has only two protons.
